mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over the previous 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL growth does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline over the previous 3 months, it signals a broad-based weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 10% and RSAFS decline in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of HOUST and RSAFS declines does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive but below 2% and retail sales (RSAFS) are declining, it signals a mismatch between economic growth and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low GDPC1 growth and RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
